## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** Treating vendor-awarded 'Certified CAIO' titles as executive credentials (no independent assessment, T0-68 G4); applying to junior 'Director, CAIO' posts expecting C-suite scope

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Programming language:** hands-on coding is not screened at C-suite CAIO level
- **Framework / SDK:** framework syntax is not screened at C-suite level
- **Library / package:** libraries are not screened at C-suite level
- **Data store:** database internals are not screened at C-suite level
- **Infrastructure / DevOps tool:** infrastructure tools are not screened at C-suite level
- **Specialised product:** individual SaaS/eval tools are delegated to platform and governance teams
- **Hardware / accelerator:** hardware engineering is not expected
- **Protocol / standard:** protocol implementation is delegated to engineering
- **Research craft:** original ML research is not expected

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- **Optional:** IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP): Preferred tie-breaker only (1/7 CAIO postings named any cert; SBI lists ML/AI/NLP cert as preferred); 6.6% GRC Careers, 8.9% Axial [B/C · T0-34, T0-65 L323] [T0-34, T0-65]
- **Optional:** PECB Certified ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor: Optional governance credibility in EU/India regulated enterprises (5/9 India governance postings; check 17024 vs ASTM E2659 scope) [B · T0-34 L58, L274] [T0-34, T0-65]
- **Optional:** ISACA Certified Information Security Manager (CISM): Optional security-governance background for CISO-to-CAIO transitions (13.2% GRC Careers, 8.1% Axial) [B/C · T0-34 L51-L52] [T0-34]

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** 12-15+ years total experience with 3-5+ years in director/VP/C-level AI or data leadership (Axial/SBI, T0-65 L323); US federal agency CAIOs are mandated by OMB M-25-21 (2025-04-03, Grade A, T0-65 L292) — private-sector CAIOs are voluntary and often dual-hatted.
- **Proof to show:** Enterprise AI delivery at scale (e.g. 100,000+ users in SBI), governance forums and independent model-validation oversight stood up, board-level vendor/build-vs-buy decisions and regulatory alignment (RBI/DPDP, GDPR, HIPAA, EU AI Act).
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** AI strategy, AI governance, responsible AI, executive leadership, model validation, regulatory compliance, board reporting, build vs buy, enterprise transformation.
